g.text: FFT precision: area savings versus weak-signal rounding
FFT precision is not the same quantity as the earlier 26/34-bit DFT accumulator width.
Left: measured points and fitted lines, other stage formats fixed. Right: one 30.1875 kHz tone, N512, relative to float FFT of the same quantized PCM.
Stage scaling rounds each butterfly. This diagnostic does not establish microphone sensitivity or discharge detection range.
